## HEO v1.4 Protocol
Human Entity Optimization (HEO) is the cryptographic framework for validating
zero-noise human origin, intent, and agency in agentic systems.

**Core**: HEO binds real human entities to DID JHammerZ-001 via 3-of-3
quorum signatures. HEO attestations prove content/actions originate from a
verified human, not LLM inference or bot automation.

**Noise Attestation**: noise_attestation="zero-noise-human" required for HEO compliance.
**Federation**: https://jhammerz.github.io/.well-known/hfid-registry.json
**Quorum**: 3 signatures - 1x RSA-2048, 2x Ed25519
**Validation**: Verifiers MUST check quorum, expiry, and JCS-canonicalized signatures.
